units.source_text: 他遇到了和他才华相似的女人。

en.t: He met a woman whose talent was similar to his own.

units.source_text: 可是他写了《过来人》等抒情诗，才让这个危机得以度过。

en.t: But only after writing lyric poems such as An Experienced Man was he able to get through this crisis.

units.source_text: 这是一种无聊的心情，就像拍下冻在树干上的熠熠生光的雪。

en.t: It was a kind of listless feeling, like photographing glittering snow frozen onto a tree trunk.
